scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

GITHUB_APP_ID.description: The App ID shown at the top of your [GitHub App settings](https://github.com/settings/apps) page.

GITHUB_APP_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID from the same GitHub App settings page.

GITHUB_APP_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Generate a client secret in your GitHub App settings.

GITHUB_APP_SLUG.description: Your GitHub App's URL slug — the `<slug>` in github.com/apps/`<slug>`.

GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Your GitHub App private key converted to PKCS8: `openssl pkcs8 -topk8 -inform PEM -outform PEM -nocrypt -in downloaded.pem`

GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: The webhook secret you set in your GitHub App settings. Any random string: `openssl rand -hex 32`

COOKIE_SECRET.description: Random string for signing sessions and invite links: `openssl rand -hex 32`
